title: Thanks from Bou

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Well, if it isn’t my favorite coffee slinger. Can’t thank you enough for stepping in like that. Really.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, if it isn’t my favorite coffee slinger. Can’t thank you enough for stepping in like that. Really.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Can’t blame you. We do make the best. Anyway, I've got good news.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can’t blame you. We do make the best. Anyway, I've got good news.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Well I've got... good news.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I've got... good news.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Morton, our delivery droid is back. So I won't be asking you for any more favors.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Morton, our delivery droid is back. So I won't be asking you for any more favors.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: I did too. Gonna miss our chats, you know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I did too. Gonna miss our chats, you know?

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Yeah, no more annoying coffee girl talking your ear off. Ha.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, no more annoying coffee girl talking your ear off. Ha.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: His dance machine got stuck on “continuous” mode. He was voguing for eight days straight before the power ran down.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: His dance machine got stuck on “continuous” mode. He was voguing for eight days straight before the power ran down.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Yeah well, he’s back out making deliveries. Good news for you, huh? No more annoying coffee girl talking your ear off. Ha.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah well, he’s back out making deliveries. Good news for you, huh? No more annoying coffee girl talking your ear off. Ha.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: You know it's funny, I see some people every day of their lives. I know their names, their allergies, their schedules but you're the only one who has ever actually stopped to talk. It made me remember something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know it's funny, I see some people every day of their lives. I know their names, their allergies, their schedules but you're the only one who has ever actually stopped to talk. It made me remember something.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: That I'm a person. That I should exist outside of this booth.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That I'm a person. That I should exist outside of this booth.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Because someday soon I'm gonna walk away from the milk frother and step onto one of these trains. See what the coffee tastes like on the other side of the departures board.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because someday soon I'm gonna walk away from the milk frother and step onto one of these trains. See what the coffee tastes like on the other side of the departures board.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Sure. Coming right up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. Coming right up.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: I'd like that. Nice to know there's more to me than coffee making skills! Speaking of, want one for the road?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd like that. Nice to know there's more to me than coffee making skills! Speaking of, want one for the road?

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Thanks for visiting PoccoCoffeeCup. We - I - hope to see you again soon.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks for visiting PoccoCoffeeCup. We - I - hope to see you again soon.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: I hope so. Anyway, here's one for the road. I'll be seeing you... maybe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hope so. Anyway, here's one for the road. I'll be seeing you... maybe.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: From someone else. Here's one for the road. I'll be seeing you... maybe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: From someone else. Here's one for the road. I'll be seeing you... maybe.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: What? No! Why would you ask that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What? No! Why would you ask that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm just in it for the free coffee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm just in it for the free coffee.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm just in it for the free coffee.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm just in it for the free coffee.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No problem. It was fun.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No problem. It was fun.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's a shame. I enjoyed it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's a shame. I enjoyed it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's a shame. I enjoyed it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's a shame. I enjoyed it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened to Morton?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened to Morton?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thank CORA for that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank CORA for that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That… doesn’t sound true.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That… doesn’t sound true.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Poor Morton.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Poor Morton.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll still come back and see you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll still come back and see you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll still come back and see you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll still come back and see you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can I get that coffee now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can I get that coffee now?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can I get that coffee now?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can I get that coffee now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why does it sound like you're saying goodbye?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why does it sound like you're saying goodbye?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why does it sound like you're saying goodbye?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why does it sound like you're saying goodbye?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like an adventure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like an adventure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But where will I get my coffee?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But where will I get my coffee?!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But where will I get my coffee?!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But where will I get my coffee?!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Always.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Always.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm good.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did you put anything in the Black Ultra Grande coffee?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did you put anything in the Black Ultra Grande coffee?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Did you put anything in the Black Ultra Grande coffee?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Did you put anything in the Black Ultra Grande coffee?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Never mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never mind.
